newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends at lows, March nears support.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends at lows, March nears support.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures ended weaker and at the day's lows as players squared positions and prepared for an abbreviated week, dealers said.
NYCE cotton futures will stop trading at 1200 EST Tuesday and the NYCE will be closed Wednesday. Trade will resume Thursday.
Market sources expect the most-active March contract to reach support at 74.00 cents, where export business is seen picking up.
The weekly export and sales figures remain slack and too low to reach the 6.2 million bales in exports the U.S. Department of Agriculture has projected for the 1996/97 season.
The March contract ended 0.76 cent lower at 74.31 cents per pound, traded 74.95 to 74.26 cents. The back months finished 0.78 to 0.25 lower.
